text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin is set to star in a<n>commercial, which is
being filmed<n>today. I decide to tag along with her to
the set.

text_block_list.name: Camera Crew Member
text_block_list.text: And cut! I want you two to take a<n>breather!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oookaaay!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I was pretty nervous at first,<n>but now I'm
starting to have fun!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Ticket's abundant facial<n>expressions are
sure to convey just<n>how fun the game is. She might
actually be suited to this line of work.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you done filming your parts,<n>Hayahide?
What are you sticking<n>around for?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It's not every day we get to act in a<n>commercial, so
I thought I'd watch<n>them film you and Ticket as
well.

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! It's brokeeen!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Huh, there's a kid crying here!<n>This is an
emergency!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what happened? I'm here to<n>help, so tell me
what's going on!

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... M-my helicopter! I trippedand... now it won't wooork!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Your helicopter's broken?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
He must have dropped it when he fell.<n>Hmm, the
motor is running fine, but<n>the propeller isn't turning
at all.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
O-oh no! What do we do?! How do<n>we fix it?! I
wanna help, but I don't<n>know anything about
machines!

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text: Hic. S-so you can't fix it? Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Sigh. Give it here. The propellerprobably just got jostled out of place.It should work fine once it's repositioned.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Really?! You can fix it, Taishin?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Uh, I dunno if I can, but I'll try.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Woooo, Taishin! You're incredible!<n>You can do it! I
believe in you!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
This bit should go here... And this<n>goes like that...
Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If the axle is here, then that must<n>mean it's
deviated to the right, no? In<n>other words, the
propeller's original<n>position should be here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so that's how it fits. Let's see...<n>This should do
the trick.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: WHIRRRRR!

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it took off! You fixed my<n>helicopter!

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text:
Wow! You're amazing, miss! You're<n>like some
engineering whiz who can<n>fix anything!

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text:
Wait, there's an engineer in a game<n>that's coming
out soon! You're just<n>like that character!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Uh, I really didn't do anything spe—

text_block_list.name: Young Boy
text_block_list.text: Thanks so much! You're the best!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That was awesome, Taishin! It was<n>so cool how
you fixed it like it was no<n>big deal!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, I barely did anything.<n>You're always so
dramatic, I swear.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Well, you are playing a<n>mechanical engineer
in the<n>commercial. Perhaps the call of a<n>broken
machine made your<n>engineering sense tingle.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Shut up.

text_block_list.name: Camera Crew Member
text_block_list.text:
Cameras are ready to roll again!<n>Let's pick things
back up from Narita<n>Taishin's engineer scene!

text_block_list.name: Camera Crew Member
text_block_list.text:
Okay, stand right there with the motor<n>and... Yes,
perfect! I love it! Do exactly<n>that when the cameras
are rolling!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Right, will do.

text_block_list.name: Camera Crew Member
text_block_list.text:
Cut! That was perfect! Let's move on<n>to the next
scene!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin nails one scene after<n>another, and her
shoot progresses<n>without a hitch.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Gah, I'm so moved! The grand sight<n>of Taishin
coming to the rescue! The<n>huge grin on that kid's
face! It was all<n>so beautifuuul!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Geez, now you're crying? Ugh, andjust when we finally got that kid tostop...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Anyway, I'm gonna take a break<n>over there.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, huh? I guess being an<n>engineer might not
be so bad...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin rests in the shade of a<n>tree as she
reflects on the boy's<n>words. She smiles gently with
a hint<n>of satisfaction in her expression.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: There's no reason to get that happyover something so simple. Not like Isaved the world...
choice_data_list: Feels pretty good to help others, huh?
Feels pretty good to help others, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Pfft. Like hell it does.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She brushes me off coldly, but I can<n>see a hint of
happiness in her<n>expression.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Awww, I'm so touched! What better<n>reward than
the gift of a smile?!<n>Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: For crying out loud! Keep it down<n>already.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The gift of a smile is quite a fitting<n>way to put it,
though. Wouldn't you<n>agree?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well... if you say so.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin offers a curt response,<n>but there's an
air of satisfaction<n>about her.
